# Validation Tests

! exec akb init foo/bar
stderr 'must not contain'

! exec akb init -- -test
stderr 'must not start'

# No knowledge base selected: status is a usage mistake.
env AKB_KB=

! exec akb status
stderr 'usage: resolve knowledge base: no knowledge base selected'

exec akb init mykb
! exec akb init mykb
stderr 'already initialized'

exec akb --kb mykb status
stdout 'Name: mykb'

exec akb --version
stdout 'akb'
